description: Get the current air quality for a set of coordinates: an air quality index (AQI, 1=Good to 5=Very Poor) plus pollutant component concentrations (CO, NO2, O3, PM2.5, PM10, etc.). Example: air_quality({ lat: 51.5, lon: -0.12 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenWeatherMap API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: air_quality
